methodology.ordering: Alternate Docker/native order every round. Never overlap services. Client concurrency is within one service only.
methodology.warmups: Warmups are retained as raw evidence and excluded from measured summaries.
methodology.prefix_cache: Every uncached request pair has a unique run/round/member tag at the beginning of the first user message. Identical paired prompts are sent to both services. Cached scenario deliberately repeats its exact prompt.
methodology.ttft: Client elapsed time from fetch start to first nonempty content/output_text delta; excludes role, created, and in_progress events.
methodology.latency: Client elapsed time until the HTTP stream ends, including terminal events and usage.
methodology.approximate_decode_rate: (server output_tokens - 1) / seconds between first and last nonempty text delta; approximate because SSE chunks can contain multiple tokens and ignore_eos may generate invisible special tokens. Full request wall rate is the primary throughput metric.
methodology.wall_rate: Server output_tokens / full request wall seconds.
methodology.concurrency_goodput: Sum of successful server output token counts / complete batch wall seconds. Never sum per-request rates. Aggregate includes failed batch wall time.
methodology.percentiles: p95 uses nearest rank; median is the central value or mean of the central pair. With 10 serial samples, p95 is the observed maximum.
methodology.scope: Comparison of the two deployed configurations, including different vLLM/Metal versions, gateway/network paths, adapters, and caches; not a controlled isolation of Docker overhead.
methodology.validation: Require HTTP success, text output, terminal event, supported finish/status and server usage. Fixed-output cases additionally require exact output token count. Invalid samples are retained and excluded from latency/rate statistics.
